purpose: Product-facing HD substitution contracts for synchronized ordinary-race racer objects.

lookup.note: The authoritative 16-bit presentation ID narrows the candidate set; the full synchronized composition guard selects the exact representation. Multiple registrations may therefore share one semantic_frame_id. Tooling may use representation_id as an explicit disambiguator. Unknown or ambiguous exact states fail closed to Original.
